about: THE MESSAGE-LOAD VERDICT CASES (test/conformance/js/messageverdict.mjs). Each case is what <Root>LoadMessages returned (n), the report it filled, and the verdict the wire-fuzz adapters owe it: delivered, refused or malformed. The verdict is the public API's, never a counter's (F-112). Read by messageverdict.test.mjs under make js-message-verdict-test (test-js).

cases.what: F-112: the public API delivered count 1 (item 50) with Oor 1; the adapter answered loaded 0, refused 1

F-112: a delivered batch of two with both counters
